title: Ground Kontrol Arcade

services.name: Mario Kart Arcade GP 2
services.desc: Start your engines, it’s-a Mario Kart time! This month, we’re featuring Mario Kart World on the Nintendo Switch 2 with Ground Kontrol prizes for the top 3 players! We’ll warm up for the tournament with open casual matches beginning in the red side lounge at 6pm, and then we’ll kick off the tournament at 7pm. Tournament sign-ups will begin at 6pm in the lounge. Tournament details: - Mario Kart World (Nintendo Switch 2) - Pro controllers & GameCube controller adapter provided (feel free to bring your own controller!) - 32 player cap - 150cc, no AI, all items, random tracks - 4 players per round, 4 races per round, top 2 players based on points earned from race results proceed to next round
